package survival_raid

import (
	survival "example.com/survival-extraction-practice/game/survival"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/nest/entitytimer"
	"time"
)

const TimerPhase int32 = 1

func (c *TimerComponent) registerTimerHandlers(h *entitytimer.Handlers) {
	h.Register(TimerPhase, func(f entitytimer.Fire) time.Duration {
		d := c.owner.Dao()
		if d.GetWakeTimer() != f.ID {
			return 0
		}
		s, e := survival.Decode(d.GetState())
		if e != nil {
			panic(e)
		}
		if s.Deadline != f.Param1 || s.Deadline != f.Deadline.UnixMilli() {
			panic(survival.ErrRule)
		}
		if e = s.Advance(f.Now.UnixMilli()); e != nil {
			panic(e)
		}
		d.SetState(s.Encode())
		d.SetWakeTimer(0)
		if s.Deadline > 0 {
			id := c.NewTimerAt(time.UnixMilli(s.Deadline), TimerPhase, s.Deadline, 0, nil)
			if id == 0 {
				panic(survival.ErrRule)
			}
			d.SetWakeTimer(id)
		}
		return 0
	})
}
